resources.string: An online match does not pause: the other player\'s game would wait for this one. Your fighter stands still while this menu is open.
Online, both phones play by the game\'s own rules: the assists count again in the next offline game.
Quit to the launcher? What the game has not saved to its memory card is lost.
Saved now; it takes effect the next time the game opens.
Everything else here takes effect at once; the picture changes when the game resumes.
No controller found. A handheld\'s own buttons count as one.
Back always opens it (and Home or Guide where Android lets the button through). For a pair, hold the first and press the second: the game does not get the second one.
Default map: the controller goes straight to the game.
Your own map: Hidden Leaf reads the controller (the sticks too) and hands the game the PS2 buttons you chose.
Choose a PS2 button, then press the controller\'s button for it (8 seconds; Back cancels). A controller button does one thing only: it leaves its old place, which is left empty.
The sticks are the PS2\'s sticks. In this menu: D-pad or left stick to move, A to choose, B to go back, L1 / R1 to change tabs, START to resume.
The menu steps aside and the controls show over the paused game. Drag a control to move it; tap it to resize, fade or hide it. Done (or Back) returns here.
In the menu: D-pad or left stick to move, A to choose, B to go back, L1 / R1 to change tabs, START to resume. The buttons\' map is in the Gamepad tab.
